<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

update_option( 'blogname', 'Example Blog' );
update_option( 'blogdescription', 'Sample content for a nice-looking llms.txt' );

$categories = array(
	'WordPress' => 'Tips, tutorials, and news about WordPress.',
	'SEO'       => 'Search engine optimization for better visibility.',
	'Travel'    => 'Trip planning tips and travel inspiration for everyday readers.',
);

$category_ids = array();
foreach ( $categories as $name => $description ) {
	$term = wp_insert_term( $name, 'category', array( 'description' => $description ) );
	$category_ids[ $name ] = is_wp_error( $term ) ? (int) get_cat_ID( $name ) : (int) $term['term_id'];
}

// The default "Hello world!" post ships uncategorized on a fresh install;
// give it a category so it doesn't show up under an "Uncategorized" group.
$hello_world = get_posts(
	array(
		'name'        => 'hello-world',
		'post_type'   => 'post',
		'post_status' => 'any',
		'numberposts' => 1,
	)
);
if ( ! empty( $hello_world ) ) {
	wp_set_post_categories( $hello_world[0]->ID, array( $category_ids['WordPress'] ) );
}

$posts = array(
	array(
		'title'    => 'WordPress 7.1 at a Glance',
		'category' => 'WordPress',
		'excerpt'  => 'The most important changes in the current WordPress release, at a glance.',
		'content'  => 'WordPress 7.1 brings numerous improvements to the block editor, performance, and accessibility.',
	),
	array(
		'title'    => 'Using Primary Categories Correctly',
		'category' => 'WordPress',
		'excerpt'  => 'How SEO plugins determine a post\'s primary category, and why that matters for llms.txt.',
		'content'  => 'Many SEO plugins let you set a primary category when a post is assigned to more than one.',
	),
	array(
		'title'    => 'Meta Descriptions That Get the Click',
		'category' => 'SEO',
		'excerpt'  => 'How to write meta descriptions that stand out in search results.',
		'content'  => 'The meta description is often the deciding sentence behind a click in the search results.',
	),
	array(
		'title'    => 'llms.txt: A New Standard for AI Assistants',
		'category' => 'SEO',
		'excerpt'  => 'Why structured llms.txt files make websites easier for AI systems to read.',
		'content'  => 'Alongside robots.txt and sitemaps, llms.txt is emerging as a new, AI-friendly format for websites.',
	),
	array(
		'title'    => '5 Tips for Planning Your Next Trip',
		'category' => 'Travel',
		'excerpt'  => 'Simple ways to plan a trip that actually goes smoothly, from budget to booking.',
		'content'  => 'A little planning goes a long way: set a budget early, book flexible tickets, and leave room for spontaneity.',
	),
	array(
		'title'    => 'How to Pack a Carry-On Like a Pro',
		'category' => 'Travel',
		'excerpt'  => 'Fit everything you need into a single carry-on with these packing habits.',
		'content'  => 'Rolling instead of folding, packing cubes, and a capsule wardrobe make a single carry-on go a long way.',
	),
);

$post_count = count( $posts );
foreach ( $posts as $index => $post ) {
	wp_insert_post(
		array(
			'post_title'    => $post['title'],
			'post_type'     => 'post',
			'post_status'   => 'publish',
			'post_content'  => $post['content'],
			'post_excerpt'  => $post['excerpt'],
			'post_category' => array( $category_ids[ $post['category'] ] ),
			'post_date'     => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime( '-' . ( $post_count - $index ) . ' days' ) ),
		)
	);
}

// New posts get post_modified = post_date, so this also controls the
// modified-date order the plugin lists pages in. "Home" has the newest
// modified date (it would sort last on its own) but is set as the static
// front page below, so it still shows up first — demonstrating that the
// front page is pinned ahead of the modified-date order.
wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_title'   => 'Contact',
		'post_type'    => 'page',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_content' => 'Have a question or feedback? Feel free to send us a message.',
		'post_date'    => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime( '-10 days' ) ),
	)
);

wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_title'   => 'About Us',
		'post_type'    => 'page',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_content' => 'We are a small team specializing in thoughtfully built WordPress plugins.',
		'post_date'    => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime( '-5 days' ) ),
	)
);

$home_page_id = wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_title'   => 'Home',
		'post_type'    => 'page',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_content' => 'Welcome to the Example Blog — practical posts on WordPress, SEO, and travel, all in one place.',
		'post_date'    => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime( '-1 days' ) ),
	)
);

update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', $home_page_id );
